integrity: The published component homotopy classification is explicitly cited as a premise, not newly proved. Finite verification checks support but do not establish the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Only standard polyhedral Hom of simple cycles with source length at least three and target length at least five; no claim about target three or four, integral quotient homology, equivariant homotopy, or definitive publication priority.
title: The integral dihedral homology module of cycle-to-cycle graph Hom complexes
